description: The make-or-break: a local Ollama classifier (qwen3:1.7b) maps a free query to ranked provider types, reading provider descriptions from the registry (no hardcoded routing). Uncertain queries WIDEN rather than narrow; --type/--all always override; --explain shows why providers were chosen.

requirements.title: Description-driven classification
requirements.description: The classifier ranks provider types using only the registry's NL descriptions and the query — no provider-specific routing code. It is swappable behind a Classifier interface.

validation.notes: Against testdata/routing_queries.json (query -> expected types), routing recall >= 0.85; precision reported.
Adding a new registry row changes routing with no classifier code change.

requirements.title: Widen-on-uncertainty + override
requirements.description: When the classifier is uncertain it widens (more provider types) rather than dropping; explicit --type/--all always override the classifier; --explain returns the routing rationale.

validation.notes: An ambiguous query routes to a wider set, not an empty/narrow set.
